    Endless Highway Dodge

    No time limit · Collision ends game · Rear overtaking after 4,000 points

    Rules & Controls ⓘ
    +100 safe pass · +50 close dodge · +250 moose dodge · −180 collision.Hitting any car or moose ends the run. Every 2,000 points increases difficulty. LKA can be toggled; holding towards the lane edge for over 2 seconds forces a simulated correction. BLIS assists if an adjacent vehicle is detected.It does not automatically avoid obstaclesAEB is separate and activates when approaching a car-length gap. Stopping does not end the game. AI rear overtaking begins after 4,000 points.

    Hold left/right arrows to steer. On desktop use A/D or arrows, S/down/space to brake. Do not imitate game driving on actual roads.
